_about: Deliberate dynamic pyegeria access that test_pyegeria_contract.py reports but should not fail on. Key: a finding id as the test prints it (import:<file>::<module>[:<name>], attr:<file>::<function>::<chain>, mcp:<tool>). Value: why it is deliberate. not_checked.advisor/report_spec_parser.py::validate_: getattr(pyegeria, client_name) on a client named in a report spec's action string. The name is data, not code, so the scan cannot see it; the report run fails visibly if it is wrong.
